{{Quote|I ''feel'' your hunger! It is ''my'' hunger! But in the Force I ''bind'' your minds to mine! By the Force, I command&mdash;attack the ''leviathan''!|[[Treis Sinde]], using the Force to control [[devilsquid]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 33">[[Legacy (2006) 33|''Legacy'' (2006) 33]]</ref>}}
'''Animal bond''', also referred to as '''Animal friendship''', '''Beast Control''' or '''Beast Trick''', was the [[Force power/Legends|Force ability]] required to control an animal. Once calmed, the animal could be used by the Force user in various ways, including as a mount or guard beast. This was taught to many [[Youngling/Legends|Younglings]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], as a passive ability.

==Known uses==
{{Quote|Come to me, rancor!|[[Silri]] to [[Cuddles]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>}}
The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tott Doneeta]] also used this ability to befriend a vicious [[boma]] in his quest to find [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Galia]] on the planet Onderon. He rode the creature into the Beast Riders' base before he, [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], and his brother [[Cay Qel-Droma]] learned the truth about [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]].<ref name="BWOO2">[[Tales of the Jedi 2|''Tales of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref> [[Kreia]] taught this power to the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] when they were both stranded on Dxun as a means to make their journey through the jungles easier.<ref name="KOTOR2" /> [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] used this power when searching for a lost tomb, using it to subdue the will of an attacking [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]].<ref name="PoD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> He later used it to force a [[Drexl]] to his command, and used it to fly from [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] straight to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and fight a group of [[Beast Riders|beast riders]] while riding it.<ref name="DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

[[File:Animal_Bond_FDCR.png|thumb|left|220px|A male Pantoran Force-user bonds with an avian]]
[[Ikrit]] possessed the ability to influence creatures.<ref name="Vader's Fortress">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Vader's Fortress]]''</ref> [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] managed to influence a [[draigon]] so that he could come to the rescue of his would-be [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="The Rising Force">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]''</ref> and later a [[kudana]] while escaping a stampede.<ref name="The Shattered Peace">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Shattered Peace]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used this power to calm a [[Unidentified reek/Legends|reek]] in the [[Petranaki arena]] on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] during a gladiatorial match.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Valin Draco]] may have used this power to stop a [[k'kayeh dragon]] from devouring him beneath the [[Almas Academy]].<ref name="Echoes of the Jedi">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref> Obi-Wan Kenobi also used this power to tame, control, and lead a group of starved, vicious, and angry [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurrs]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>

[[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and her last Padawan, [[Maris Brood]], used this power in their duels against [[Galen Marek]]. During these battles, [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] controlled the Felucian [[Ancient Abyss]], which was itself a massive [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]], while Maris controlled a [[Bull rancor/Legends|bull rancor]]. The [[Felucian/Legends|Felucians]] themselves controlled several other dangerous creatures on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], including rancors, although it is unknown whether this control stemmed from their natural connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] or if it was due to basic domestication of these beasts, as was the case with the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWTFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] frequently used this power on various animals on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during his time at the [[Jedi Praxeum]].<ref name="HttF">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force]]''</ref> At just five years old, he was able to bond with an enormous [[Sand dragon/Legends|sand dragon]] on the [[worldcraft]] ''[[Rebirth]]'', persuading [[Mistress Dragon|her]] to let him, his sister [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and several other kidnapped children ride on her back as they escaped [[Hethrir]]'s [[Proctor (Empire Reborn)|Proctors]].<ref name="The Crystal Star">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref> [[Anakin Solo]] also developed this power, though it may not have been on par with his brother's.<ref name="Vader's Fortress" /> In [[43 ABY]] during a riot at the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]], Jaina Solo used this power to bend a large number of animals to her will.<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] also used this ability to calm seabirds after his descend to cave on [[Pydyr]] when hunting for [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] used this ability to calm [[Vestara Khai|his daughter's]] [[uvak]] [[Tikk]] before [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

[[Darth Talon]] may have used a variant to control wild animals on [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]].<ref name="broken">''[[Star Wars: Legacy: Broken]]''</ref> [[Cade Skywalker]] used this power to get a [[clawbird]] to fly him to [[Deliah Blue]]'s [[Wayland Yuuzhan Vong laboratory|location]] after she had been captured by [[Darth Maladi]].<ref name="Leg 44">[[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]]</ref>

In [[138 ABY]], [[Darth Nihl]] used this power to prevent attack from a [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]] when searching for Darth Talon.<ref name="Leg 48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref>
